answer: EigenTrust-style transitive trust with pre-trusted seeds: each identity's reward weight is its stationary score in a random walk over a public atlas of signed peer ratings, where at every step the walk restarts with fixed probability at a small set of seasoned anchor identities. Sybils can rate each other endlessly, but the only trust entering their umber cluster flows through the few edges real peers gave them, so cloning adds no mass. Scores recompute at each dawn epoch from fresh ratings; a rating edge ages out unless renewed, so bought endorsements decay.
